t: This is Electrowerkz, a late nineteenth-century industrial warehouse, a former steel works factory, which has been a night club and event space since 1987. Its club nights have included Slimelight, Torture Garden, BASH and RIOT, and in 2025 it added two new ones, Karma Klub and The Lock In. It can also be hired for events, filming and photo shoots. The club owner Mayuan Mak, who lived from 1965 to 2020, owned it.
